chunks.title: Handling of ICR Consumption Marking against job order GRN
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › Handling of ICR Consumption Marking against job order GRN
chunks.text:
System should ask user to specify Input Material consumption during Job order GRN Creation. Same as available for PRPO GRN. Existing Setting Name: Specify material consumption details at the time of GRN creation in Process Order Setting.
We also need to handling of Input Consumption Tolerance allowance to user while marking Input Consumption during Job order GRN Creation & Job Order ICR Marking.
Note : This should applicable for only outsourced Job Order only
Allow Input Consumption Marking on PRPO
Setting Path: Admin Company Setup Process Order Settings Specify material consumption details at the time of GRN creation.(working for Job Order as well)
Existing screen: -
New Screen: -
Validations :-
• This pop grid data will be depending on the color-size wise dependency.
• In case on 0 qty in the receiving the system will not consider the value of input.
• Adhoc article consumption should mark automatically.
• By default, the input qty will comes through the Routing of the Job Order.
• This should be open for outsource job order only.
We also need to handle these setting by below given approach.
1. Do not show Input Material Details on PRPO Print Preview
2. Display Input Consumption & Wastage in Process Order View- No need in Job order
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › Handling of ICR Consumption Marking against job order GRN

chunks.title: Handling of ICR Consumption Marking against job order GRN
chunks.heading: Functional Requirements › Handling of ICR Consumption Marking against job order GRN
chunks.text: Solution: We need to open the Job order print on the click of job order number as it is working right now in the current UI. By default, system will show the output article details in the print. If any case client wants to show the input article detail then we should handle this through BI print only. For this we need to give an option to provide the mapping in layout engine mapping on admin section.
chunks.locator: § Functional Requirements › Handling of ICR Consumption Marking against job order GRN (part 2)
